name: – Billy Kelleher – After § 19 – Am 8
title: REPORT on gender inequalities in health, specifically as regards gender-specific conditions
part_text: 19b. Emphasises that safe and effective healthcare requires patients to provide complete and accurate information on all clinically relevant aspects of their health, including their biological sex and anatomy; stresses that healthcare professionals should not incur liability for consequences directly resulting from a patient’s deliberate withholding of such information, nor for declining an examination or treatment which, on objective biological or clinical grounds, falls outside their professional competence, is medically inappropriate or cannot be safely performed, including where clinically relevant information provided or recorded does not correspond to the patient’s biological or anatomical characteristics; underlines that any such decision must be duly justified and must respect the duties of non-discrimination, confidentiality and emergency care;
